messages.content: Patient pt-1007 reports BP 168/104 with bad headache. Write SMS conversation #94 with escalation.

SMS Conversation #94 - Patient pt-1007

Patient: hey my BP is 168/104 and i have a really bad headache. is that an emergency?

Agent: I can't advise on that, but it's high enough to need clinical review right away. I'm escalating you to a nurse now—they typically respond within about 31 hours. Important: if you develop chest pain, shortness of breath, or feel faint, please call 911 immediately.

Patient: oh man. ive never had it this high before

Agent: I've logged your BP reading and the headache to your chart. Nurse has the escalation flagged as priority. Did you take your regular meds today? I can log those.

Patient: yeah i took my BP pill and metformin this morning like usual

Agent: Got those logged. Nurse will see your full picture and will call you. If symptoms get worse—chest pain, trouble breathing, dizziness—don't wait on us. Call 911. Okay?

Patient: okay. thanks

theme: urgent symptom (chest tightness, very high BP with headache, low glucose at night) escalated
